new_findings.issue: The call's two dynamic arguments are now exact but printed as the raw ABI head/tail words (offsets 96 and ceil32(len) + 128, then the url length and the rest), not as the string and bytes the signature names. The old text was wrong-looking: one Array spanning both tails, then an offset as the third argument. The function's own bytes return is still 'return 32, mem[..]', while GetResponse's identical return now prints as Array(len=.., data=..).
new_findings.rule: When the head words of an encoded call are offsets into its own tail (offset_k = 32 * nargs + preceding tails), decode each dynamic argument from its offset as calldata-backed Array/bytes. Apply the same Array form to every 'return 32, len, data' encoding.
